test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If sum of ₹8,000 invested at 10% per annum interest compounded half-yearly, amounts to ₹9,261, then what is the time period?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 8000 

Rate of interest = 10% p.a = 5% half-yearly

Amount = Rs. 9261

**Formula used:**

A = P × [1 + (R/100)]t

**Calculation:**

⇒ 9261 = 8000 × [1 + (5/100)]t

⇒ 9261/8000 = (21/20)t

⇒ (21/20)³ = (21/20)t

⇒ t = 3 half-year

**∴ Time is 1(1)/(2) years.**
